environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer configured with a default HTTPS listener forwarding all traffic to the target group on port 8080. ALB has no additional listener rules or rule actions beyond the default forward. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and 8080 from ALB SG to instance. No WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The application runs as a systemd service under a non-root user with read/write access to /var/lib/app/users.db.
